subject: Review space-datalab-metafilter#2: CDS returns snow_depth as sde, not sd (v0.1.0 defect)
description: Cross-vendor review of TobiasEdman/space-datalab-metafilter PR #2 at head a18d9c7ae7fde2230f6bd1031a433f4a8df50092, base master@a815f0ee22673ab15868143ab275f94d60e16bb1 (the v0.1.0 integration commit). Live CDS testing found that reanalysis-era5-land returns a snow_depth request as 'sde', while calculate_daily_metrics tested for 'sd'; snow_depth_mean_m was therefore never derived from real CDS data and the shipped sentinel1_default profile failed outright on every credentialed run. Neither prior review could catch it: fixtures and review stubs both encode the assumed name. The fix reads sde first and sd second, converges the Open-Meteo adapter on sde, moves fixtures to sde, and pins the live short-name map in tests. A live sweep of all 11 requested variables confirms snow_depth was the only mismatch. Return PASS or BLOCK bound to the exact head; on PASS integrate as the Codex identity and tag v0.1.1 on the resulting master, superseding v0.1.0 as the shareable tag. Id 0101 per the collision lesson.
